reason: Pass 4 (propagation) requires callee address lists, but the MCP wire schema for noreturn_infer only exposes {address, name, body_hex} per function. The 'callees' field is not in the input schema, so caller propagation cannot be triggered via JSON-RPC.

Pass 3 (tail-call) requires rec.callees to be populated, which the MCP wire schema does not expose. Even if body bytes end with JMP rel32, the pass cannot identify the target callee without a callees list.
